title: Discover
description: Understand the product goal, users, and constraints before touching a single component — requirements, edge cases, and success metrics first.

title: Design
description: Translate requirements into component hierarchies, state models, and interaction patterns — wireframe the data flow, not just the UI.

title: Develop
description: Build with reusable, typed components and a clear state-management strategy, keeping the codebase scalable as features grow.

title: Test
description: Cover critical flows with Jest and React Testing Library, then validate accessibility, responsiveness, and edge cases by hand.

title: Deploy
description: Ship through CI with performance budgets in place — Lighthouse scores and bundle size are release gates, not afterthoughts.

title: Maintain
description: Monitor, fix, and iterate post-launch — performance regressions and bug reports get the same rigor as new feature work.
